notes.title: AGEOD special Sales
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[b]Don’t miss out on our special deal on the entire AGEOD games catalog.[/b]

If you haven’t heard yet, on[b] June 4th[/b], we are releasing our new strategic 4X game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34556788/2208a629574e40e2e9d50bc0f2cd4cbab53be7cb.jpg[/img]

[b]Field of Glory: Kingdoms[/b] is the latest game from the award-winning studio AGEOD, known for creating some of the best grand strategy games of all time. Set in 1054, just after the Great Schism, it covers more than two centuries of epic European, African, and Middle Eastern history.

[b]Here's a quick overview of the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] 375 factions
[*] 325 units
[*] 600 buildings
[*] 14 religions/heresies
[*] 90 cultural traits (all new)
[/list]

If you want to learn more, follow the game on:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985050/Field_of_Glory_Kingdoms/

[url=https://discord.gg/3Xrm3ge5wQ]Join our Discord community[/url]


And don't forget to check out the Dev Diaries:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1985050/view/4178854131307887205

notes.title: Ageod's Thirty Years’ War is released on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Thirty Years’ War[/b], probably one of the most accurate wargames depicting the dark period of the wars of religion that spread out across all Europe for the first half of the XVII century, is [b]finally available on Steam![/b]

Fight with the Catholics or the Protestants in over three decades of merciless war for the control of the Holy Roman Empire, but build your alliances carefully: who is your friend today could be your worst enemy in the future!

With all the major nations playable, 5 historical scenarios and with over 160 different types of units at your disposal, [b]Thirty Years’ War[/b] recreates the complexity of this period, from the first logistic systems to the intricacy of the diplomatic relations between the powers involved!

The level of detail is simply stunning!

[b]Grab this jewel now![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/477750/

notes.title: Thirty Years' War is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
EDIT: the release date has been moved to June, 9th

[i]“For what can war but endless war still breed?”[/i]
	John Milton

[b]1618.[/b] The protestant nobles of Bohemia reject the election of the catholic Ferdinand of Styria as king and rise in open revolt against the Holy Roman Emperor. This seemingly local conflict is the spark which will ignite all of Europe, dooming it to three decades of warfare and sectarian violence: [b]it is the Thirty Years’ War![/b]

[b]Thirty Years’ War[/b], the wargame developed by HQ Studio and brought to life thanks to the AGE Engine, is coming to Steam!  

[b]Thirty Years’ War[/b] explores a period and a subject which hasn’t been touched by many other games, putting you at the head of one of many military machines taking part to the conflict. Fight across all of Europe on a massive map with more than 4600 regions, commanding hundreds of different unit types, and structuring your army into a chain of command of your liking with dozens of historical commanders! Gain an edge over your enemies with superior maneuvering and organized logistics! Direct your war effort by enacting political decisions and witness many historical events, which alter the course of the war!

[i]“Not only a jewel of a game but an excellent history lesson"[/i] – [url=http://www.armchairgeneral.com/thirty-years-war-pc-game-review.htm]Armchair General[/url]

[b]Thirty Years’ War[/b] is coming to Steam next week on [b]June 9th[/b]. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/477750
